lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters organized into vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with inter-blob distance increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement of high-luminance anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, manifesting as a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and lower luminance (shadowing) on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense population of small-diameter, high-luminance spots localized on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the primary flank.
